title: And the Kaiser Abdicates: The German Revolution, November 1918-August 1919
coverage: Imperial Germany's wartime strains, the November Revolution, competing socialist movements, the Kaiser's abdication, Spartacist uprisings, National Assembly, and formation of the Weimar constitutional order

title: A History of the Third French Republic
coverage: The Franco-Prussian defeat, fall of the Second Empire, Paris Commune, conservative-republican struggle, republican consolidation, Boulangism, Dreyfus affair, church-state conflict, and prewar political order

title: Brazil Today and Tomorrow: Historical and Social Selections
coverage: Colonial expansion, independence, imperial consolidation, abolition, fall of the monarchy, formation and early crises of the republic, regional power, migration, race, education, press, and social organization

title: Turkey: The Awakening of Turkey and the Turkish Revolution of 1908
coverage: Ottoman reform and reaction, the rise and organization of the Young Turks, military discontent, the 1908 revolution, constitutional government, counterrevolution, parliament, and deposition of Abdul Hamid II

title: American Visions of the Netherlands East Indies/Indonesia: US Foreign Policy and Indonesian Nationalism, 1920-1949
coverage: Indonesian nationalism under Dutch rule, Japanese occupation, formation of the republic, armed and diplomatic struggle, internal party conflict, international mediation, the Madiun crisis, and recognition of independence
